title: Armageddon as a kinetic war against the returning Son of God

tellings.quote: Armageddon is a war with the son of God returning to the earth. And I believe that's a kinetic war.

plain: Armageddon, the final battle at the end of time in the Bible, will be a real, physical war of weapons, fought against the Son of God as he returns to Earth. That is the belief of a researcher named Tim Alberino, who gives it as his own reading of the Bible and of a work he calls Birthright, without pointing to any other source.
